prompt: How many Los Angeles Metro Rail stations are served by both the A Line and at least one other Metro Rail line?
answer: 7 stations: 7th Street/Metro Center, Grand Avenue Arts/Bunker Hill, Historic Broadway, Little Tokyo/Arts District, Pico, Union Station, and Willowbrook/Rosa Parks.
